# Velair 1.4.0

Velair 1.4.0 brings focused usability improvements to Profiles, clearer
feedback when applying configuration changes, and a more informative Overview.

Several refinements in this release were shaped by feedback from users testing
Velair in their own Home Assistant setups. Thank you to everyone who shared
questions, observations, and practical suggestions during the beta.

## ✨ Added

- Clone a Profile schedule day to multiple weekdays directly from the editor
  while preserving all supported climate options.
- Follow progress and completion feedback when changing Modes or activating
  Profiles in the Velair panel and the Active setup Lovelace card.

## 🚀 Improved

- Overview zone cards now place climate identity before Profile and Comfort
  signals, followed by a balanced status summary that combines reported
  activity, Velair control state, HVAC mode, and timing without duplication or
  inference.
- The Mode editor places Save beside the mode name and uses clearer responsive
  spacing on desktop and mobile.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Profile schedule drafts are preserved when temporarily switching a zone to
  Default or Pause while editing.
- Reduced intermittent Lovelace card configuration errors during Home Assistant
  startup by making the frontend resource available earlier.

## 🧭 Notes

- Update through HACS when possible, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the
  browser or companion app.
- When using the optional Lovelace cards, confirm that
  `/velair_frontend/velair-card.js` is registered as a JavaScript module. See
  the Troubleshooting guide if a card shows a configuration error.
